name: soft_ref_weight1.k
model:
class SoftRefItem {
  ok:Bool
}

class SoftRef1 {
  good:SoftRefItem
  bad:SoftRefItem
  pick:SoftRefItem

  req good.ok

  req !bad.ok

  req pick = good || pick = bad

  soft req pick = bad

  soft req pick.ok weight 3
}

main:SoftRef1
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (main Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((SoftRefItem (mk-SoftRefItem (ok Bool)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((SoftRef1 (mk-SoftRef1 (good Ref)(bad Ref)(pick Ref)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-SoftRefItem (sel-SoftRefItem SoftRefItem))
  (lift-SoftRef1 (sel-SoftRef1 SoftRef1))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-SoftRefItem ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-SoftRefItem (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-SoftRefItem ((this Ref)) SoftRefItem
  (sel-SoftRefItem (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-SoftRef1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-SoftRef1 (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-SoftRef1 ((this Ref)) SoftRef1
  (sel-SoftRef1 (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-SoftRefItem ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-SoftRefItem this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-SoftRef1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-SoftRef1 this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.main: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!main ((this Ref)) Ref
  (main (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ----------------------------------
;   Getters for class SoftRefItem:
; ----------------------------------

; --- getters for SoftRefItem.ok: ---

(define-fun SoftRefItem.ok ((this Ref)) Bool
  (ok (deref-SoftRefItem this))
)

; -------------------------------
;   Getters for class SoftRef1:
; -------------------------------

; --- getters for SoftRef1.good: ---

(define-fun SoftRef1!good ((this Ref)) Ref
  (good (deref-SoftRef1 this))
)

; --- getters for SoftRef1.bad: ---

(define-fun SoftRef1!bad ((this Ref)) Ref
  (bad (deref-SoftRef1 this))
)

; --- getters for SoftRef1.pick: ---

(define-fun SoftRef1!pick ((this Ref)) Ref
  (pick (deref-SoftRef1 this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-SoftRef1 (TopLevelDeclarations!main this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))



; ------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class SoftRefItem:
; ------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-SoftRefItem SoftRefItem)
(declare-const const-2-SoftRefItem SoftRefItem)
(declare-const const-3-SoftRefItem SoftRefItem)



; ---------------------------------
;   Invariant for class SoftRef1:
; ---------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-4-SoftRef1 SoftRef1)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun SoftRef1.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-SoftRefItem (SoftRef1!good this))
)

(assert (! (SoftRef1.inv1 4) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun SoftRef1.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-SoftRefItem (SoftRef1!bad this))
)

(assert (! (SoftRef1.inv2 4) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun SoftRef1.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-SoftRefItem (SoftRef1!pick this))
)

(assert (! (SoftRef1.inv3 4) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun SoftRef1.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (SoftRefItem.ok (SoftRef1!good this))
)

(assert (! (SoftRef1.inv4 4) :named _xkassert4))

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun SoftRef1.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (not (SoftRefItem.ok (SoftRef1!bad this)))
)

(assert (! (SoftRef1.inv5 4) :named _xkassert5))

; --- Invariant 6: ---

(define-fun SoftRef1.inv6 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or (= (SoftRef1!pick this) (SoftRef1!good this)) (= (SoftRef1!pick this) (SoftRef1!bad this)))
)

(assert (! (SoftRef1.inv6 4) :named _xkassert6))

; --- Soft Constraint 7: ---

(define-fun SoftRef1.soft7 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (SoftRef1!pick this) (SoftRef1!bad this))
)

(assert-soft (SoftRef1.soft7 4) :weight 1 :id k_soft)

; --- Soft Constraint 8: ---

(define-fun SoftRef1.soft8 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (SoftRefItem.ok (SoftRef1!pick this))
)

(assert-soft (SoftRef1.soft8 4) :weight 3 :id k_soft)




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-SoftRefItem const-1-SoftRefItem))
        2 (lift-SoftRefItem const-2-SoftRefItem))
        3 (lift-SoftRefItem const-3-SoftRefItem))
        4 (lift-SoftRef1 const-4-SoftRef1))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (good (sel-SoftRef1 (select heap 4))))))
  (ok (sel-SoftRefItem a!1))))
(define-fun const-2-SoftRefItem () SoftRefItem
  (mk-SoftRefItem false))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 4))
(define-fun _xkassert6 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (= (pick (sel-SoftRef1 (select heap 4)))
              (good (sel-SoftRef1 (select heap 4)))))
      (a!2 (= (pick (sel-SoftRef1 (select heap 4)))
              (bad (sel-SoftRef1 (select heap 4))))))
  (or a!1 a!2)))
(define-fun const-1-SoftRefItem () SoftRefItem
  (mk-SoftRefItem true))
(define-fun const-4-SoftRef1 () SoftRef1
  (mk-SoftRef1 1 2 1))
(define-fun const-3-SoftRefItem () SoftRefItem
  (mk-SoftRefItem false))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (bad (sel-SoftRef1 (select heap 4))))))
  (is-lift-SoftRefItem a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (bad (sel-SoftRef1 (select heap 4))))))
  (not (ok (sel-SoftRefItem a!1)))))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (main (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-SoftRef1 a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (pick (sel-SoftRef1 (select heap 4))))))
  (is-lift-SoftRefItem a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (good (sel-SoftRef1 (select heap 4))))))
  (is-lift-SoftRefItem a!1)))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
                         0
                         (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 4)))
                  1
                  (lift-SoftRefItem (mk-SoftRefItem true)))))
(let ((a!2 (store (store a!1 2 (lift-SoftRefItem (mk-SoftRefItem false)))
                  3
                  (lift-SoftRefItem (mk-SoftRefItem false)))))
  (store a!2 4 (lift-SoftRef1 (mk-SoftRef1 1 2 1))))))
